nuggets.text: Noah Fifita is a rare quarterback who has played all five of his college seasons at the same school, Arizona.
Noah Fifita moved into second in Arizona history in career passing yards and leads active FBS players with 75 touchdowns.
Noah Fifita threw his first college touchdown pass to Tetairoa McMillan, his high school teammate at Servite.
The Wildcats held Northern Arizona to minus-7 rushing yards, their first time holding a foe below zero since 2006.
Brent Brennan and BYU coach Kalani Sitake worked together on the Oregon State coaching staff in 2015.
The Wildcats' 'Bear Down' motto comes from 1926 quarterback John 'Button' Salmon's final words: 'Tell the team to bear down.'
The Wildcats' mascots, Wilbur and Wilma Wildcat, got married in 1986.
The Wildcats' first mascot was a real bobcat named Rufus Arizona, introduced in 1915.
The Wildcats got their name in 1914, when the Los Angeles Times said Arizona 'showed the fight of wildcats.'
The Wildcats' last win in Provo came in 1975; they are 3-5 all-time there.
